description: Get the weather forecast for a point on the map. Give latitude and longitude and get the next five forecast periods for it: the period name, its temperature, wind speed and direction, and the plain-language forecast. US locations only. No API key and no account: discovery is free, a call costs $0.003 in USDC on Base via x402, and nothing is charged when the request returns no data. Free tools: health and tools/list.
name: get-forecast
